A photography tip I’ve frequently been given is to “print your work.” I’m starting just by cataloging things and making contact sheets. #filmphotography #believeinfilm
Misty night. #FilmPhotography #BelieveInFilm #Kodak Tmax p3200
Just some things out in town. Ilford HP5+ & a Canonet QL17 #filmphotography
Took and developed my first roll of 120 film. The scan’s a little blurry because it was done by hand with my phone. 🎞️ HP5+ 📸 Mamiya C330 #FilmPhotography

Final darkroom class: making prints. Here’s some negatives, a contact sheet, and then final print. It was a ton of fun. Kind of amazing that these never went through a computer. Used #Ilford paper & HP5+ film. #filmphotography
Took a photography class this weekend. We developed and scanned negatives. Film is Ilford HP5+ #filmphotography
Been wanting to try this for a while! #filmphotography #kodak

Got this funny double (triple?) exposure when I guess I wasn't quite winding the film or maybe the sprocket failed to engage the film. The rest of the roll was fine. Lucky SHD400 (at ISO 200), Canonet G-III QL17 #filmphotography

Glued it all together. There’s a lot of little holes where the gaps between boards are. Hey camera knowers, is letting lots of unsanctioned random light into your camera good? This will be more gaffer tape than wood when I’m done with it. #filmphotography #pinholecamera

Working on a laser cut pinhole camera design. It's getting close but I've still got to figure out a few things like how to estimate kerf, for example. Learning a ton about AutoCAD though! #filmphotography #pinholecamera
